dashboard.title: Daily Training
dashboard.description: Plan, track, and review daily training sessions for each horse you manage.
dashboard.alertsDescription: Unresolved watch and alert events from Training, Health, Analytics, and Rule Engine modules.
dashboard.selectHorseDescription: Choose which horse you are planning training for today.
dashboard.todaysPlanDescription: Overview of the active plan block for the current training day.
dashboard.todaysExercisesDescription: Planned exercise blocks for this session.
dashboard.recentSessionsDescription: Latest training activity for quick context.
dashboard.calendarDescription: Current month session status for the selected horse.
dashboard.summaryDescription: Session totals and completion rate for the selected horse.
dashboard.activityDescription: Sessions logged over the last 7 days.
dashboard.recentNotesDescription: Latest session notes for the selected horse.
dashboard.readyDescription: Start a live session to work through today's exercises, track progress, and save feedback.

empty.selectHorsePlanDescription: Choose a horse to view the active training plan for today.
empty.noActivePlanDescription: Create or activate a training plan to see today's schedule and goal here.
empty.selectHorseExercisesDescription: Choose a horse to load today's planned exercises.
empty.noExercisesDescription: There is no training session scheduled for today yet. Exercises will appear once a session is logged.
empty.selectHorseSessionsDescription: Choose a horse to view recent training sessions.
empty.noSessionsDescription: Completed and skipped sessions will appear here once you start logging training.
empty.selectHorseCalendarDescription: Choose a horse to view the monthly training calendar.
empty.selectHorseSummaryDescription: Choose a horse to view training performance summary.
empty.selectHorseActivityDescription: Choose a horse to view recent training activity.
empty.noActivityDescription: Sessions from the last 7 days will appear here once you start logging training.
empty.selectHorseNotesDescription: Choose a horse to view recent session notes.
empty.noNotesDescription: Session notes will appear here after you finish training with notes saved.
empty.noHorsesDescription: Add a listing, stallion profile, or pedigree horse you manage to start tracking daily training.

session.exercisesDescription: Complete or skip each exercise. Notes are saved automatically.
session.noExercisesDescription: Exercises are optional. You can finish this session without a preset outline.
session.feedbackReadOnlyDescription: Saved feedback from this completed session.
session.feedbackEditDescription: Rate the session and add notes. Changes save automatically.
session.completeAllHint: Complete or skip every exercise to finish.
session.notFound: Training session not found. It may have been deleted or you may not have access.

sessionNotes.placeholder: Capture observations, adjustments, or reminders for this session...

reflection.coachNotesPlaceholder: Technical notes for your coach or trainer
reflection.overallNotesPlaceholder: How did the session go overall?

plans.headerDescription: Build multi-week training plans you can reuse across horses. Plan structure and session generation will arrive in upcoming phases.
plans.planCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 plan available} other {# plans available}}
plans.emptyDescription: Create your first reusable multi-week plan to organize training blocks across horses.
plans.createDescription: Name your plan, then add weeks, daily exercises, and horse assignments in the editor.
plans.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional overview of what this plan covers.
plans.planStatusHint: Set to Active after saving exercises and assignments so horses receive daily sessions.
plans.placeholderDescription: The full plan editor with weeks, days, and exercises will be added in a later phase.
plans.placeholderEditorDescription: This screen reserves space for the multi-week plan builder. You will be able to define weeks, daily goals, and exercise blocks before assigning plans to horses.
plans.placeholderDaysDescription: Set daily goals and session focus.
plans.placeholderExercisesDescription: Attach catalog exercises to each day.
plans.restDayDescription: No exercises scheduled. Recovery and turnout recommended.
plans.assignmentsDescription: Select one or more horses that should use this plan on the Daily Training dashboard when the plan is active.
plans.noManageableHorsesDescription: Add a listing, stallion profile, or pedigree horse you manage before assigning this plan.
plans.horsesSelected: {count, plural, =1 {1 horse selected} other {# horses selected}}
plans.addExerciseDescription: Choose an exercise to add to {dayLabel}.
plans.noExercisesAvailableDescription: System and custom exercises will appear here once they exist in your library.
plans.deletePlanDescription: This permanently removes the plan, its weeks, days, exercises, and horse assignments. Existing training sessions and horses are not deleted.
plans.deletePlanAssignedWarning: {assigned} — those horses will no longer have this active plan.

analytics.title: Horse Analytics
analytics.description: Professional training analytics powered by your session history, ratings, workload, and coach feedback.
analytics.selectHorseDescription: Analytics are scoped to each managed horse's training history.
analytics.selectHorseEmptyDescription: Choose a horse to view training analytics, trends, and recommendations.
analytics.summaryDescription: Aggregated metrics from the horse_training_summary database view.
analytics.healthAlertsDescription: Fever, lameness, farrier, vaccination, and injury rules affecting combined readiness.
analytics.insightsDescription: Modular rule evaluations for fatigue, workload, consistency, recovery, and jumping balance.
analytics.loadDescription: Completed session duration over the last 30 days.
analytics.frequencyDescription: Most frequently logged exercises across all sessions.
analytics.feelingsDescription: How this horse has felt across completed sessions.
analytics.coachNotesDescription: Latest technical notes saved during session reflection.
analytics.readinessDescription: Combined score from training rules (Fatigue, Workload, Consistency, Recovery, Jumping Balance) and health rules (Fever, Lameness, Farrier, Vaccinations, Injuries).
analytics.ratingsEmpty: Rider ratings will appear here after you complete sessions with ratings saved.
analytics.frequencyEmpty: Exercise frequency will populate once sessions include planned exercises.
analytics.feelingsEmpty: Horse feeling data will appear after you record it on completed sessions.
analytics.coachNotesEmpty: Coach notes from completed sessions will appear here.
